VI.description: Converts a point from screen coordinates to the client coordinates of the window hWnd through user32.dll ScreenToClient (stdcall\2C called in any thread). The point travels to the DLL as a POINT {LONG x\2C LONG y} that the function overwrites in place. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Handle of the window whose client area the point is converted to (HWND\2C passed as an unsigned pointer-sized integer).
x of the point in screen coordinates (pixels).
y of the point in screen coordinates (pixels).
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: x of the point relative to the top-left corner of hWnd's client area.
y of the point relative to the top-left corner of hWnd's client area.
